full_prompt_en: A saturated pink and plum illustration frames a young animated girl from the chest upward amid dense flowering foliage. Her head sits near the center, but the dark mass of short, tousled hair expands in loose pointed curls across nearly the full width of the image. She looks upward and to the right with enormous pale eyes, tiny pink irises, lifted brows, and a slightly open mouth, giving her an alert, uncertain expression. Both hands are raised close beneath her chin, fingers curled together, and her narrow arms lead down into a pale puff-sleeved blouse and a dark sleeveless dress. Soft rosy blush warms her cheeks. Behind her, layered leaves, small blossoms, and thin scrolling stems fill the frame without turning into a strict pattern. Some shapes are clearly outlined; others dissolve into painterly dark pink and violet patches. The background rises from deep wine tones at the lower edges to brighter magenta around her face and hair, creating a loose halo of light. A few tiny light accents float through the foliage. The linework is dark, expressive, and slightly irregular, especially around eyes and hair, while translucent brush textures give the color a handmade quality. Diffuse, rosy illumination flattens harsh shadows but separates the pale face and blouse from the plum surroundings. The whole image feels intimate, emotional, and softly magical.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅饱和粉色与深紫色插画把年轻动画少女从胸部以上框在浓密开花植物之间。她的头位于画面中央附近，短而蓬乱的深发却以松散的尖卷扩展到几乎整幅宽度。她向右上方望去，巨大的浅色眼睛中有细小的粉色虹膜，眉毛抬起，嘴唇微张，神情警觉而略不安。双手举到下巴下方，手指蜷曲靠拢，纤细手臂向下接入浅色泡泡袖衬衫与深色无袖裙。双颊有柔和的玫瑰色红晕。身后层叠叶片、小花与细卷茎填满画面，却没有形成严格图案。一些形状轮廓明确，另一些则消融在绘画般的深粉和紫色斑块中。背景从下缘深酒红逐渐过渡到面部和头发附近更明亮的洋红色，形成松散光晕。几处细小亮点漂浮在植物之间。深色线条富于表情且略不规则，尤其围绕双眼和发丝；半透明刷痕赋予色彩手工质地。漫射的玫瑰色照明弱化硬影，同时让浅色脸部和衬衫从深紫环境中分离。整幅画亲密、富于情绪，带有温柔魔幻气息。
style_prompt_en: The illustration combines expressive animation character drawing with painterly botanical density. A narrow analogous palette moves through wine, plum, violet, magenta, dusty pink, and a few pale peach highlights. Irregular dark contours define the most expressive features, while overlapping semi-transparent brush shapes let the surroundings feel lush and atmospheric. Large eyes and compact facial marks bring emotional clarity; energetic curved strokes keep the composition buoyant. Background detail is abundant but softens around the focal area through value and color contrast. Illumination is diffused and rosy, with no sharp cast shadows. The finish is textured, intimate, and gently whimsical.
style_prompt_zh: 插画把富有表情的动画造型绘法与绘画式植物密度结合。狭窄的邻近色域在酒红、深紫、紫罗兰、洋红、灰粉间移动，少量浅桃色提亮。略不规则的深色轮廓定义最具表现力的特征，重叠的半透明色块则让周围环境丰茂而有空气感。夸张的大眼与简洁面部记号带来清晰情绪，充满活力的弧线笔触维持构图的轻盈。背景细节丰富，却通过明度与色彩反差在焦点周围柔化。照明漫射而偏玫瑰色，没有尖锐投影。完成质地有纹理、亲密，并带温柔的奇想感。
theme_en: A wide-eyed animated girl with windblown dark hair clasps her hands beneath her chin amid dense pink foliage.
theme_zh: 一位睁大眼睛的动画少女站在浓密粉色植物间，深色头发飞扬，双手合在下巴下。
name: Rebecca Sugar
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
